reason: I already pay for a chatbot and it does the job. A cartoon mascot on my site feels childish for my brand, and switching means migration work for a gain I can't see.
objection: A cute cartoon character would make my site look unprofessional, and I'm not redoing my chatbot setup for a gimmick.
would_change_my_mind: A serious, non-cartoon avatar style that fits a professional brand, plus a one-click import of my current chatbot's content and proof it converts better than what I have.
